---
title: "Analytical Series"
---

For panel analysis, this project partitions the *Current well-being* dataset into **analytical series**, each defined by a unique combination of measure, unit of measure, age group, sex, education level, and domain.

This project-defined grouping is designed for panel diagnostics; it is not an official OECD indicator count or a claim that OECD defines SDMX series in the same way.

The interactive inventory in @tbl-series-explorer lists every project-defined analytical series identified by the panel-diagnostics pipeline and ranks them by **completion rate**, from highest to lowest. Use the search box to filter the inventory. Click any row to open a series-specific diagnostic page.

::: {.data-note}
### [Completion rate]{.smallcaps}

**Completion rate** is the share of observed reference area–time-period cells in the rectangular panel implied by the reference areas and time periods represented in an analytical series. A high completion rate indicates dense panel coverage, but does not by itself imply strong balance.
:::
